evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage and pruning in `src/node/blockstorage.{cpp,h}` and block index traversal.
rationale: Eliminates an O(M * N) iteration over the block index while holding cs_main that froze node startup for 75 seconds on x86_64 and 10 minutes on Raspberry Pi 5 when switching a full chain to pruned mode. Author benchmarks demonstrate a speedup from 75.1s to 14.7ms on x86_64 and 606.0s to 26.3ms on Raspberry Pi 5.
